note: The concentration report. It reads the hidden tab Concentration.Exposure and the Holdings tab. Every cell is a label, a formula, the threshold cell B22, or the overlap minimum cell B23. B3 counts the holdings that we can't see inside. B8 and B9 read the run-time block A15:B24 of Concentration.Exposure. B11 holds the coverage label of the measures. The company table, the section of the funds that we can't see inside, the block of the holdings that are not stocks, the total, and the fund overlap list are one spill from A26.

values: Your stock exposure by company, with a look inside each fund.
A fund that holds other funds uses the newest report of each held fund. The date of a held report can differ from the date in this table.

=LET(uu,'Concentration.Exposure'!$AC$5:$AC,
n,COUNTIF(uu,">1E-12"),s,SUM(uu),
IF(n=0,"",n&IF(n=1," holding ("," holdings (")&IF(s<0.01,"less than 1%",TEXT(s,"0%"))&" of your portfolio) "&IF(n=1,"is a fund","are funds")&" we can't see inside."))
Top 10 stocks, share of your stocks
Type a percent. Each company whose stock is at or above it gets a row.
Type a percent. The fund overlap list under the tables shows each pair of funds at or above it.
A commodity trust or a crypto trust, such as GLD or IBIT, counts as one stock.

 LET(blk,SORT(HSTACK(FILTER(LN,sel),FILTER(LT,sel),FILTER(LX,sel),FILTER(dw,sel),FILTER(LS,sel)),3,FALSE),
  sw,CHOOSECOLS(blk,3),mx,MAX(sw),

  HSTACK(SEQUENCE(ROWS(sw)),CHOOSECOLS(blk,1,2),ARRAYFORMULA(sw*tot),sw,
   MAP(sw,LAMBDA(x,SPARKLINE(x,{"charttype","bar";"max",mx;"color1","#2a78d6"}))),
   ARRAYFORMULA(ROUND(CHOOSECOLS(blk,4),12)),fx))),
rsel,ARRAYFORMULA((LP="stock")*ISNUMBER(LX)*(LX<thr)),
rw,SUMIFS(LX,LP,"stock",LX,"<"&thr),

uid,IFNA(FILTER('Concentration.Exposure'!$AB$5:$AB,'Concentration.Exposure'!$AB$5:$AB<>""),""),
uu,IFNA(FILTER('Concentration.Exposure'!$AC$5:$AC,'Concentration.Exposure'!$AB$5:$AB<>""),0),
cx,{"","","","","","","x"},
cu,LET(q,IFNA(FILTER(uid,uu>=0.01),""),
 IF(INDEX(q,1,1)="",cx,
  LET(qw,IFNA(FILTER(uu,uu>=0.01),0),qe,MAKEARRAY(ROWS(q),1,LAMBDA(i,j,"")),

csn,SUM(ARRAYFORMULA(IF((uu>1E-12)*(uu<0.01),1,0))),
csw,SUM(ARRAYFORMULA(IF(uu<0.01,uu,0))),
cs,IF(csn=0,cx,HSTACK("Holdings under 1% ("&csn&")","",csw*tot,csw,"Add its fund mix: Concentration › Describe a fund","","")),
cdn,SUM(ARRAYFORMULA(IF(MI<>"",1,0))),
cd,IF(cdn=0,cx,
 LET(ki,IFNA(FILTER(MI,MI<>""),""),kw,IFNA(FILTER(MW,MI<>""),0),ke,IFNA(FILTER(ME,MI<>""),0),
  kt,IFNA(FILTER(MT,MI<>""),""),kp,IFNA(FILTER(MP,MI<>""),0),ks,IFNA(FILTER(MS,MI<>""),FALSE),
  kn,MAP(ke,LAMBDA(d,"Mix entered "&TEXT(d,"mmmm yyyy")&IF(TODAY()-d>182," — check the fact sheet",""))),
  kr,HSTACK(MAP(ki,LAMBDA(v,hn(v))),ARRAYFORMULA(kt&IF(ks," (substitute)","")),ARRAYFORMULA(kw*kp*tot),ARRAYFORMULA(kw*kp),kn,ki,
   MAKEARRAY(ROWS(ki),1,LAMBDA(i,j,0))),
  ku,UNIQUE(ki),
  kv,MAP(ku,LAMBDA(v,XLOOKUP(v,ki,kw)*(1-SUM(IFNA(FILTER(kp,ki=v),0))))),
  ko,HSTACK(MAP(ku,LAMBDA(v,hn(v))),MAKEARRAY(ROWS(ku),1,LAMBDA(i,j,"Not described")),ARRAYFORMULA(kv*tot),kv,
   MAP(ku,LAMBDA(v,XLOOKUP(v,ki,kn))),ku,MAKEARRAY(ROWS(ku),1,LAMBDA(i,j,1))),
  SORT(VSTACK(kr,IFNA(FILTER(ko,kv>1E-9),cx)),6,TRUE,7,TRUE))),
cv,VSTACK(cu,cs,cd),
can,IFNA(FILTER(CHOOSECOLS(cv,1,2,3,4,5),CHOOSECOLS(cv,7)<>"x"),{"We can see inside each of your holdings.","","","",""}),
cb,MAKEARRAY(ROWS(can),1,LAMBDA(i,j,"")),
keep,ARRAYFORMULA(ISNUMBER('Concentration.Exposure'!$AJ$5:$AJ)),
nown,SUM(keep),
on,FILTER('Concentration.Exposure'!$AH$5:$AH,keep),ok,FILTER('Concentration.Exposure'!$AG$5:$AG,keep),oc,FILTER('Concentration.Exposure'!$AI$5:$AI,keep),
ow,FILTER('Concentration.Exposure'!$AJ$5:$AJ,keep),came,FILTER('Concentration.Exposure'!$AK$5:$AK,keep),

 LET(sc,INDIRECT("Holdings!C"&hs,FALSE),sy,ARRAYFORMULA(IF(ROW(sc)=1,"",sc)),de,INDIRECT("Holdings!C"&hd,FALSE),
  MAP(on,LAMBDA(n,IFNA(XLOOKUP(n,sy,de),n))))),
kind,MAP(ok,oc,on,LAMBDA(k,c,n,IF(LEFT(k,9)="residual:","not looked through",IF(RIGHT(n,16)=" (not described)","not described",

ownRows,HSTACK(oname,kind,ARRAYFORMULA(ow*tot),ow,came),

gn,FILTER('Concentration.Exposure'!$AO$5:$AO,grp),

gk,MAP(cls,LAMBDA(x,SWITCH(x,"stock","bond or other security","fund","fund, not looked through",x))),
gf,FILTER('Concentration.Exposure'!$AP$5:$AP,grp),
grpAll,HSTACK(gl,gk,ARRAYFORMULA(gw*tot),gw,gf),

sm,ARRAYFORMULA(1-big),
ng,IF(SUM(grp)=0,0,SUM(big)),
nsm,IF(SUM(grp)=0,0,SUM(sm)),

fw,'Concentration.Exposure'!$I$5:$I,
pwt,LAMBDA(v,IFNA(XLOOKUP(v,MI,MW),XLOOKUP(v,'Concentration.Exposure'!$D$5:$D,fw,""))),
